description: Dependency-update policy for docker-autoheal. Renovate creates and maintains dependency PRs, but all updates require manual review and merge.

packageRules.description: Require manual review and merge for all dependency updates. No Renovate update is automatically merged.
Pin Docker image tags to an immutable SHA256 digest as well as their human-readable tag/version where the registry supports digests.
tommye123/docker-autoheal is this project's own published image, not a third-party dependency. Renovate should not manage it.
